_doc: Phase 2 (October 2026) cost ledger. Starts at ¥0 on 2026-10-01 00:00 JST. Net Profit = Gross Revenue - Cost. Platform fees are booked automatically by the monitors where the API exposes them; operators book everything else via `node scripts/oct/ops.mjs cost ...`. Unknown attributable cost (e.g. subscription compute) is jpy_equivalent:null — counted as unknown, never as zero. Paid spend (ads, X API credits, new subscriptions) must be booked the same day it is committed.
fx_note: USD at ~150 JPY for reporting; provider billing is authoritative.
